description: PortalNode-01: 4U rack-mount on-premise inference server for 2ndOpinionMD + RISE. Tiered eoh-llama deployment (3.2/8B/70B). HIPAA-ready, air-gapped after initial model load. $12–15k prototype.

budget.note: Consumer-grade parts, enterprise rack packaging. Priced at retail; volume discount possible.

global_constraints: All images are technical product photography — the component as you would see it on a vendor product page or datasheet.
Style: photorealistic 3D render, soft studio lighting, neutral dark gray background, clean technical aesthetic.
Show actual physical components with correct form factors, dimensions, and visual features.
Labels and annotations are minimal — physical accuracy over text. Do NOT render text on components unless it is an actual product marking.
No people. No conceptual diagrams. Components only.

chassis.name: 4U Rack-Mount Server Chassis
chassis.description: Standard 4U rack-mount chassis with front-to-back airflow. Must fit 4x full-length triple-slot GPUs, E-ATX motherboard, and redundant PSU.

cots_parts.description: 4U rackmount, 15x drive bays, 7x full-height expansion slots, front-to-back airflow, steel construction, 25.6" deep

chassis.assembly_notes: Remove all 5.25" bay covers for GPU clearance. Install 3x 120mm intake fans in front, 2x 120mm exhaust in rear.

motherboard.name: Workstation Motherboard — 4-GPU Support
motherboard.description: Workstation-class motherboard with 4x PCIe x16 physical slots, DDR5 ECC support, dual M.2 NVMe, IPMI/BMC for remote management.

cots_parts.description: Intel W790 chipset, LGA 4677, 7x PCIe 5.0 x16, 8x DDR5 ECC DIMM, 2x M.2, dual 10GbE, IPMI/BMC, E-ATX

motherboard.assembly_notes: IPMI/BMC provides out-of-band management (dedicated RJ45 port). Dual Intel X710 10GbE onboard.

cpu.name: Intel Xeon w5-2465X Processor
cpu.description: 16-core workstation CPU with 112 PCIe 5.0 lanes for full-bandwidth 4-GPU operation. Coordinates FastAPI router and Ollama instances.

cots_parts.description: 16 cores / 32 threads, 3.1 GHz base / 4.7 GHz turbo, 33.75 MB cache, 112 PCIe 5.0 lanes, LGA 4677, 200W TDP

cpu.assembly_notes: LGA 4677 socket. Apply thermal paste (pre-applied on cooler). Secure ILM latch.

cpu_cooler.name: Tower CPU Cooler
cpu_cooler.description: Large tower air cooler for 200W TDP Xeon. Air cooling preferred over liquid for server reliability and zero maintenance.

cots_parts.description: Single-tower, 150mm height, 1x 140mm NF-A15 PWM fan, 6 heatpipes, 200W TDP rating

cpu_cooler.assembly_notes: Verify LGA 4677 mounting kit compatibility (Noctua NM-i4677 SecuFirm2 kit may be separate purchase). 150mm height clears 4U chassis.

ram.name: 128 GB DDR5-4800 ECC RDIMM
ram.description: 128 GB total in 4x 32 GB registered ECC DIMMs. ECC required for server workload reliability. DDR5-4800 is native Xeon w5 speed.
ram.assembly_notes: Install in matching DIMM slots per motherboard manual (typically A1/B1/C1/D1 for 4-channel). Verify RDIMM (not UDIMM) compatibility.

gpu_array.name: 4× NVIDIA RTX 4090 Founders Edition
gpu_array.description: Four RTX 4090 GPUs providing 96 GB total VRAM. GPU 0–1 dedicated to eoh-llama 8B + 3.2 (always-on). GPU 2–3 dedicated to eoh-llama 70B (on-demand). Founders Edition uses flow-through cooler design suited for dense multi-GPU configuration.

cots_parts.description: AD102 GPU, 24 GB GDDR6X, 16384 CUDA cores, 450W TDP, 12VHPWR power connector, flow-through dual-fan cooler, 3-slot width

gpu_array.assembly_notes: Install in PCIe x16 slots 1/3/5/7 (every other slot for airflow). Each card requires one 12VHPWR (16-pin) power cable from PSU. Total GPU power: 4 × 450W = 1800W peak. Verify 12VHPWR cable seating — firm click required.

nvme_os.name: OS + Logs NVMe — 2 TB
nvme_os.description: Boot drive. Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Docker images, ProvenanceEngine provenance logs, JSONL session records.

cots_parts.description: 2 TB, M.2 2280, PCIe 4.0 x4, 7450/6900 MB/s read/write, 1200 TBW endurance

nvme_os.assembly_notes: Install in M.2 slot 1 (CPU-direct lanes). Boot partition + Docker + /var/log.

nvme_models.name: Models + Graph NVMe — 8 TB
nvme_models.description: Model weight storage: eoh-llama 3.2 (~2 GB), eoh-llama 8B (~5 GB), eoh-llama 70B (~40 GB). Plus RISE knowledge graph. 8 TB provides room for multiple model versions and full graph history.

cots_parts.description: 4 TB, M.2 2280, PCIe 4.0 x4, 7100/6600 MB/s read/write

nvme_models.assembly_notes: Install in M.2 slots 2–3. Software RAID 0 via mdadm for 8 TB volume, or JBOD with symlinks. Model weights load into VRAM at Ollama startup — NVMe speed matters for cold start only (~6 seconds for 70B).

psu.name: 2000W Redundant Power Supply
psu.description: 2000W 80+ Platinum for 4× RTX 4090 (1800W) + CPU (200W) + overhead. Redundant/hot-swap preferred for server uptime. Must provide 4x 12VHPWR connectors (native or via adapters).

cots_parts.description: 1600W, 80+ Titanium, fully modular, digital monitoring, 12x 8-pin PCIe — NOTE: need 12VHPWR adapters

psu.assembly_notes: AX1600i provides 1600W sustained — sufficient for inference workload (GPUs rarely hit 450W TDP during inference, typical 250–300W each). For full 450W×4 stress, consider dual PSU configuration with add2psu adapter. Route 12VHPWR cables first before seating GPUs.

fans.name: Chassis Cooling Fans
fans.description: High-static-pressure 120mm fans for front intake and rear exhaust. Front-to-back airflow across GPU array.

cots_parts.description: 120mm, 3000 RPM, 110.26 m³/h, 43.5 dBA, IP67 dust/water rated, 4-pin PWM

fans.assembly_notes: Front fans: intake (arrow toward rear). Rear fans: exhaust (arrow out of chassis). PWM fan headers on motherboard — set curve to ramp at 70°C GPU temp via IPMI.

network.name: 10GbE Network (Onboard)
network.description: Dual Intel 10GbE onboard (included with ASRock Rack W790 WS motherboard). No add-in card needed. Plus IPMI dedicated port.
network.assembly_notes: Dual 10GbE + IPMI included on motherboard. Port 1: inference API traffic (FastAPI :8000). Port 2: RISE EHR data ingestion. IPMI: remote management for IT staff. RJ45 connectors — use Cat6a cabling.

stages.title: NVIDIA RTX 4090 Founders Edition — Single Card
stages.description: A single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Founders Edition graphics card. The card has NVIDIA's distinctive Founders Edition design: a dark gunmetal/titanium colored metal shroud with two large axial fans visible on the front face. The shroud has a clean geometric design with angular lines. The card is large — approximately 336mm long, occupying 3 expansion slots in width. Photographed from a 3/4 top-front angle showing the fan side, power connector, and card length.

stages.title: 4× RTX 4090 Founders Edition — Quad Array
stages.description: Four NVIDIA RTX 4090 Founders Edition graphics cards standing upright in a row, side by side, as they would be oriented in PCIe slots (PCIe connectors at bottom, fans facing viewer). stages.title: PortalNode-01: Lid On, Rack-Mounted, Cables Connected
stages.description: The final product shot. The PortalNode-01 chassis is now closed (lid on) and installed in a standard 19-inch open-frame server rack. The 4U server sits at eye level in the middle of the rack, secured by rack-mount rails. The front panel faces the camera: ventilated mesh grille, rack-mount handles, and the three small LED indicators glowing green (power), blue (GPU activity), and amber (network). Power cable runs from the rear of the chassis down the left side of the rack through a vertical cable manager. Two green ethernet cables and one blue management cable run down the right side. Below the server, a 1U rack-mounted UPS unit. Above the server, blank 2U filler panels. The rack is in a clean, well-lit server room with white walls and raised floor tiles. The impression: this is a production deployment. Professional, real, ready.
